name: Set Visibility
description: Shows or hides a scene component and, optionally, propagates that change to its child components. Useful for toggling meshes, lights, particles, or entire hierarchies on/off at runtime.

inputs.name: Target
inputs.description: The component whose visibility should be set. Connect a Get reference to a mesh, light, particle, or other scene component.

inputs.name: New Visibility
inputs.description: True to show the component, false to hide it. Hide does not disable collision or tick - use Set Actor Hidden In Game for actor-wide hiding.

inputs.name: Propagate to Children
inputs.description: If true, the change is also applied to all child components attached beneath this one in the hierarchy.

outputs.name: Out
outputs.description: Execution pin that fires after the visibility change is applied. Continue the graph from here.
